item.description: Agents per space (Allow agents switch; agents see only the spaces you allow), notify_user and ask_user alert tools, split view by dragging a tab onto another, drag pinned tabs to reorder, sidebar right-click menus (new tab, ghost tab, space; move tab to space; floating window), History group by site, import from Arc, Check for Updates via Sparkle. Fixes: downloads stuck after the confirm sheet, popups like Outlook's pop-out compose covering the sidebar.
